articles.body:
Hi,

The decision letters we generate still have the old coat of arms in the header. We changed our graphic profile in May and communications is on my back about it.

I have attached the new logo files in the formats our comms unit delivered.

Best,
Karin

articles.body:
Hi Karin,

New logo is in place in your letter template in production since this morning. I generated a test decision letter on a draft case and it looks correct, but please have your comms unit confirm the placement before you send a real batch.

Best,
Mia Berg
Customer success, Minso
